# Awara Hostels & Dormitory

> Public information about dormitory accommodation in Chowk, Lucknow, near KGMU.

- Website: https://awarahostels.com/
- About: https://awarahostels.com/about.html
- Contact: https://awarahostels.com/contact.html
- Booking and stay information: https://awarahostels.com/terms.html
- Human-readable Markdown: https://awarahostels.com/awara-hostels.md
- Read-only MCP endpoint: https://awarahostels.com/api/mcp

## Final discounted tariffs
- Hall Dormitory: ₹299 per bed / night
- 4-Bed Dormitory: ₹350 per bed / night
- 8-Bed Mixed Dormitory: ₹399 per bed / night
- 1BHK Cooler Room: ₹999 per room / night
- 1BHK AC Room: ₹1,500 per room / night
- 2BHK Entire Room: ₹2,999 per room / night; prior confirmation required

## Important booking note
A booking request is not a reservation. Guests must confirm availability, any applicable taxes, payment method and cancellation terms with Awara. The website does not take online payment.
